👁️ Eye Pattern: Doll-Like Eyes
Large, round, glassy eyes with minimal expression — an uncanny, porcelain-doll quality with prominent highlight reflections.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.

Portrait: Apply doll-like eye styling with smooth glassy surfaces, clean simple iris shapes, and an uncanny stillness. This is eye appearance only; do not create synthetic status unless other traits support it.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
